correctness.rationale: On x0² chart the coordinate algebra A=C[t²,z_i,t z_i]⊂B=C[t,z_i], with S=C[t²,z], B=S⊕tS, A=S⊕t(z)S and B/A=tC[t²]. Annihilator conductor is (z_i,tz_i) in A and (z_i) in B. Double cover P¹→P¹ [a:b]↦[a²:b²] yields quotient sheaf O_D(-1). Binomial relations z_iw_j=z_jw_i and w_iw_j=yz_i z_j give distinct even/odd semigroup monomial normal forms, proving endpoint complete local presentation. At nonbranch y≠0 choose formal sqrt(y); a_i=w_i+sqrt(y)z_i, b_i=w_i−sqrt(y)z_i, giving a_i b_j=0.
